checks.details: Maven 3.9, neither [lock] maven nor a Maven wrapper names one

raeva.lock holds no plugin tables, so it pins no Maven plugins, and build extensions only for a module that resolves a dependency type Maven's core does not define: '[plugins] lock = true' in raeva.toml locks the plugins and build extensions, and '[plugins] trace' the artifacts they fetch while they run (https://github.com/raeva-io/raeva/blob/main/docs/offline-builds.md)
no CI file runs raeva sync --frozen, so nothing checks raeva.lock against the POMs; a job to add is below (https://github.com/raeva-io/raeva/blob/main/docs/ci.md)
raeva.lock is not marked as generated, so pull request diffs show it in full; the line to add is below (https://github.com/raeva-io/raeva/blob/main/docs/ci.md)

snippets.text:
# With raeva <raeva-version> installed (https://github.com/raeva-io/raeva/blob/main/docs/ci.md); on GitHub Actions,
# raeva-io/setup-raeva with `check: true` runs this.
raeva -C project sync --frozen
